from pathlib import Path
import gzip,hashlib,json,re,subprocess
r=Path('experiments/results/inten_geometric_prior');out=r/'publication_final_discovery'
sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
for name in ['publication_final_discovery','capture_final_discovery_workers']:
 p=r/'commands'/name;receipt=json.loads(p.with_suffix('.json').read_text());assert receipt['exit_code']==0
 for suffix,digest in receipt['logs'].items():assert sha(p.with_suffix(suffix).read_bytes())==digest
commands=json.loads((out/'commands.json').read_text());assert len(commands)==7 and all(x['exit_code']==0 for x in commands)
assert commands[-1]['argv'][-5:]==['-m','unittest','discover','-s','tests']
log=(out/'06.stderr').read_text();count=int(re.search(r'^Ran (\d+) tests in ',log,re.M)[1]);skips=int(re.search(r'^OK \(skipped=(\d+)\)$',log,re.M)[1])
summary=json.loads((out/'summary.json').read_text());assert summary['commands_all_passed'] and summary['historical_source_unchanged'] and all(summary['regenerated_tables_byte_equal'].values())
capture=json.loads((out/'worker_receipts/capture.json').read_text());assert set(capture['groups'])=={'old','01','08','02'}
workers={}
for group,entry in capture['groups'].items():
 assert entry['exit_code']==0
 for name,digest in entry['files_sha256'].items():assert sha((out/'worker_receipts'/name).read_bytes())==digest
 raw=gzip.decompress((out/'worker_receipts'/f'{group}.json.gz').read_bytes());assert sha(raw)==entry['output_sha256']
 old=json.loads((r/'publication_recorded_runtime/worker_receipts'/f'{group}_command.json').read_text());assert old['exit_code']==0 and old['output_sha256']==entry['output_sha256']
 workers[group]=entry['output_sha256']
validated=json.loads((r/'commands/publication_final_discovery.json').read_text())['source_commit']
changed=subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only',validated,'HEAD'],text=True).splitlines();assert all(p.startswith(str(r)+'/') for p in changed)
report=dict(full_discovery_exit_code=0,tests_run=count,tests_skipped=skips,all_worker_outputs_match_prior_executed_outputs=workers,validated_source_commit=validated,current_production_and_tests_match_validated_commit=True,all_checks_passed=True)
(r/'fresh_discovery_audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+chr(10))
print(json.dumps(report))
